label: GPT-6 Luna
output:
**An open letter to my friends, neighbours, school families and everyone this reaches**

I’m safe. I’m staying with my sister in Rondebosch with Marmalade, who is also safe — though she spent two hours hiding under a car after we got out. Furniture can be replaced. Marmalade can’t.

I’m writing one message for everyone because my phone has been going mad since Saturday night, and I’m too tired to answer each person individually. Please don’t be offended if I’m slow to reply to messages or comments. I’ve been crying at so many of them, and I’m so grateful for all the love.

A fire started at around 11:40pm on Saturday, 7 November, in a ground-floor flat at Lindale Court on Station Road in Obs. I’m in flat 12, on the second floor. Everyone got out. Two people were treated for smoke inhalation at Groote Schuur and sent home. The fire department says an electrical fault is a possibility, but they’re still investigating, so I don’t want to speculate.

I woke up because our neighbour, Uncle Faizel, was going door to door on our floor in his vest and slippers, making sure everyone got out. I grabbed my phone and Marmalade. I didn’t have time to take anything else.

There’s smoke and water damage throughout my flat, and the lounge ceiling came down. Our landlord says nobody will be able to go back in for at least six weeks. I don’t want to go over every detail, but it’s a lot to take in.

Some of you know that I teach the Ladybirds — the Grade 00 class of four- and five-year-olds — at Little Acorns Pre-Primary in Mowbray. I had brought home things to laminate for the end-of-year concert: 22 crowns and the children’s handprint banner. They’re gone, but the concert on 27 November is still happening, and the Ladybirds will have crowns. Please don’t worry about that.

I’ll be back at school on Wednesday. I’d be grateful if we could keep things low-key in front of the children. I don’t want them to feel they need to worry about me.

As for what would actually help: Zinhle has set up a BackaBuddy fundraiser to help me with the deposit for a new place. The target is R25,000, and it had reached R11,400 this morning. I feel strange asking for help, but Zinhle told me to shut up and accept it — so I’m trying.

**This is Zinhle’s fundraiser:**  
backabuddy.example/thandi-lindale-court

Please be careful: there is another page called “Thandi Fire Relief” on a different site, as well as a WhatsApp message asking people to EFT money to a Capitec account. **That is not my fundraiser, and I’m not connected to it.** I’ve reported it. Please use only the BackaBuddy link above, and if you’re unsure about any other appeal, check with me or someone you know personally before sending money.

If you’d like to help in another way, I need school shoes and work clothes in size 6 / size 34, and a working laptop if anyone has an old one they no longer need. All my lesson planning was on mine.

I don’t need more clothes in general — I have plenty, and I’ll pass any extras along to people from the other flats. I also don’t need food; my sister’s freezer is full. Please don’t feel you have to send something. Kind messages and patience mean a lot too.

One of the children’s mums left a bag of clothes at my sister’s gate at 7am on Sunday without even knocking. I can’t explain how much that meant. People have been so kind, and I’m grateful even when I don’t manage to say so straight away.

Thank you for checking in, sharing the fundraiser, and looking out for me and everyone at Lindale Court. I’m safe, Marmalade is safe, and I’m taking things one day at a time.

With love,  
**Thandi**
